name: WEMIX Dollar
oneLiner: WEMIX Dollar is the WEMIX ecosystem's centralized dollar token, backed by USDC and fiat reserve assets on the non-EVM-indexed WEMIX chain.
collateral: USDC and fiat reserve assets held for WEMIX Dollar on WEMIX3.0; issuer materials describe full collateralization by secure on-chain and off-chain assets.
pegMechanism: Issuer-managed mint and redemption system using WEMIX$ treasury collateral, DIOS stabilization, and USDC/fiat reserve management to keep WEMIX$ near one U.S. dollar.

blacklistabilityReview.sourceFreeRationale: Resolved from Pharos stablecoin metadata by the blacklistability resolver; no separate manual override source is attached.
blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Inferred review retained: WEMIX$ resolves to Yes because existing metadata classifies the asset as centralized and no manual override narrows that status.

notices.title: Non-indexed issuance chain
notices.message: WEMIX Dollar primarily circulates on WEMIX chain, which is not EVM-indexed by Pharos. No on-chain contract is stored; supply and metadata are supplemented by external sources only.

mintAuthority.summary: WEMIX$ is issued through the WEMIX3.0 MINT contract under Authorized Mint Access (AMA), granted only to the WEMIX foundation at launch, against USDC deposited into the Treasury; an algorithmic DIOS stabilizer manages the peg but the mint permission is concentrated in the issuer.

controls.label: WEMIX Authorized Mint Access (AMA) holder
controls.evidence: WEMIX docs state issuance is controlled by the MINT contract and that the AMA (Authorized Mint Access) right was granted only to the WEMIX foundation at launch, minting WEMIX$ 1:1 against USDC deposited to the Treasury; DIOS (TIP/TOP) is an automated stabilizer rather than an open mint route, so supply creation is permissioned to the issuer.

review.evidence: WEMIX$ is the WEMIX3.0 ecosystem stablecoin minted via the MINT contract under Authorized Mint Access held by the WEMIX foundation, with USDC Treasury collateral and an automated DIOS price stabilizer; there is no permissionless or user-collateralized mint path.
review.sourceFreeRationale: WEMIX chain is non-EVM-indexed and no contract is stored in Pharos; mint mechanism resolved from issuer docs (AMA + MINT + DIOS) rather than a live on-chain admin read.
unresolvedQuestions: Resolve the on-chain AMA/MINT contract owner on WEMIX chain and whether AMA has been extended beyond the foundation.
